observation: With nvidia-smi replying "not a csv", getSystemMetrics() parses the line, finds fewer than 3 comma fields, and returns WITHOUT throwing — so the Math.random() catch branch never runs and /metrics reports gpu=0, vram=0, vramUsage="0/0" alongside real cpu/ram. plan.md §9 trap 4 lists the unexpected CSV shape as a simulated-path trigger; recorded legacy runtime evidence (plan §4 step 1) says it is a silent-zero path.
simulatedPathRequires: an execSync throw: missing binary or non-zero exit (see J2c-metrics-fail)
